Moon texture attribution

Solarsystemscope_texture_2k_moon.jpg (2048 x 1024) by Solar System Scope.
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Solarsystemscope_texture_2k_moon.jpg
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The texture is used as the moon's albedo map; apparent phase and illumination
are applied by the atmosphere shader. The source describes the map as based on
NASA elevation and imagery data, with slightly saturated colors and gap fill.
